gallery.alt: A guest in a white dress smiles as she speaks into a cream telephone handset at an evening reception, with other guests laughing and raising glasses around her.
A couple share a white telephone handset in front of an 'I just called to say' neon sign framed by trailing white flowers.
Calleo phones on display: a light blue rotary phone with Calleo branding, an ornate brass rotary phone and a pink phone.
Wedding guests gather around a table in a stone-walled room while a woman in a green dress speaks into a cream rotary phone.
A bride and groom at a white telephone-box stand holding a handset, beside a 'Happily Ever After' neon sign and a stone wall.
A bride and groom in white heart-shaped sunglasses share a pale pink phone handset in front of a copper tinsel backdrop.
A bride in an off-shoulder gown holds a red rotary phone and its handset beside a decorated Christmas tree.
Black-and-white table styling: a Calleo rotary phone with coupe glasses, white roses, a miniature gin bottle and a table-number card.
A guest seated on a stool laughs while talking on a pale blue rotary phone, next to a 'To the moon and back' neon sign.

notes: Logo: single-colour (#f9fafa off-white) potrace reconstruction of Calleo's own site-header wordmark PNG (2500x1184, fetched with Accept: image/png; sha256 aa22b9ce...60a8f2). Calleo publishes no SVG. Off-white mark, so it needs the dark (navy) plate. Trace QA: mean abs diff 0.16 on white (not meaningful for a white mark) and 3.69 on navy at 600 px; letterforms and the rotary-dial speech-bubble 'o' visually match.

Other genuine brand marks found but not used: black rotary-dial loader mark and black dial-in-speech-bubble favicon (calleo-uk.com), and the white wordmark uploaded to Booked Events (lower resolution than the site header).

Reel: 3 clips from the calleo-uk.com homepage background video (public Squarespace HLS, 1920x1080, ~12.6 s, four shots of keepsakes: QR song print, vinyl, engraved USB, video book) plus 3 of Calleo's own landscape photos as still segments. The fourth video shot (0-2.6 s, a smartphone held close to the lens scanning the QR print) was left out as less sharp and dominated by the handset.

TikTok: 8 @calleouk posts were tried. 3 were photo-slideshow posts (yt-dlp returned audio only; deleted unused). The 5 videos were not used: burned-in text captions throughout (7554828522418638102, 7560017338418875651, 7571159657109097750; the last also opens with talking-head speech), a 'Calleo tour' of ~1 s shots, too short for 2-3 s clips, with captions at the start and end (7561878016595332375), and caption-covered phone shots followed by shaky dance-floor footage that doesn't clearly show the product (7545174947736587522).

Gallery: 9 photos from calleo-uk.com (Squarespace CDN), converted to WebP (longest edge 1600 px, q80). Photographer credits in Calleo's filenames/Image Credits page include Harry Michael, Lewis Cannon, Char Cook, Suzy Elizabeth (Notley Abbey), Gina Fernandes, Patrick Partridge and Nick Rutter/Nick Cannon.
The Booked Events 'calleo' listing's current 'Mensah' title/featured photo belong to an unrelated MC business and were not used.
